snippet.title: Toilet 8 🚽🪠 Trailer (with Spoilers) on Steam, iOS, Android #exit8
snippet.description:
Toilet 8 is a short, silly, absurd horror game where you’re trapped in an infinite loop of bathrooms…
and every loop hides a stupid little anomaly.
If something looks wrong, go back.
If everything looks normal… don’t turn around. Seriously.
Because in these cursed toilets, even a fart can kill you.

Explore endless restrooms, spot the weirdest details, survive the loop, and try to reach the legendary Toilet 8.
It’s creepy, it’s dumb, it’s chaotic, and it absolutely does not take itself seriously.

If you love liminal spaces, psychological loops, or just high-quality toilet stupidity, you’re gonna love this one.

👉 Download Toilet 8 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4142980/Toilet_8/
👉 Download it on the AppStore: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/toilet-8/id6755677576
👉 Download it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.okashi.toilet8

Don’t miss it… or the anomaly will catch you first.
